videos.title: EP. 1-1 | Word Continuation With The Hospital Fam (feat.Chaos, Deja vu) | The Game Caterers 2 X Dr. Park’s Clinic
videos.overview:
From a self-sustaining life at Three Meals A Day, now Doctor Lee Seo Jin returns in glory!

Together with Ra Mi Ran, Cha Cheong Hwa, Shin Eun Jung, Kim Kwang Kyu, Jung Hyeong Seok, Seo Bum Jun, get ready for the TVING Original Dr. Park’s Clinic’s hilarious game competition!  Get ready to watch the family like hospital colleagues show off their perfect teamwork...
